Remove the existing crontab (0 19 * * * ~/stschaef.github.io/build.sh) which builds and deploys the public website. Website publishing is being redesigned separately (see Website Publishing Redesign).

fr:mainmatter.html:p: Serve the forest on the Tailscale network so iPad/phone can browse it.

html:ul.html:li: Run forester build forest.toml on a 15-minute systemd timer, producing output/
Serve output/ statically via caddy on port 8888 (Tailscale-only)

fr:mainmatter.html:p: We originally planned forester serve (HTMX mode), but hit URL routing bugs — the slug link generator builds /HOST/X/ paths that don't match the server's /trees/X router. Static build sidesteps this; the XSLT link routing emits relative hrefs which work from any origin.
An HTTP endpoint on macproseph (Tailscale-only) that accepts shared content from iPad, phone, or desktop and creates a tree for it.

html:ul.html:li: Accepts POST with text, PDF, or URL
Allocates a tree ID via forester new
Writes tree content with appropriate tags (e.g. capture, handwriting for PDFs)
Commits and pushes to origin so the laptop picks it up on next sync

html:ul.html:li: Laptop pushes to origin on a schedule
macproseph pulls from origin on a schedule
Captures on macproseph commit + push to origin
Laptop pulls captured trees on next sync cycle

fr:title.text: Gotcha: Set Variable needs explicit WFInput

fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Gotcha: Set Variable needs explicit WFInput

fr:mainmatter.html:p: iOS does not auto-wire Set Variable to the previous action's magic variable. Without a WFInput dictionary referencing a producer's UUID and OutputName, the stored variable is empty at runtime.

The generator assigns a UUID to every producer action (Ask, Dictate, Choose From List, Combine Text, Get Text, Download URL, Get Dictionary Value), and every consumer references those UUIDs through action_output_ref. This was the root cause of the URL and File shortcuts posting empty payloads.
Helper:
Wiring at the call site (from the tag picker block):
fr:mainmatter.html:pre: choose_uuid = uid() return [ choose_from_list(FIXED_TAGS, uuid_=choose_uuid), set_var("FixedTags", source=action_output_ref(choose_uuid, "Chosen Item")), ... ]

fr:title.text: Gotcha: Build tag in the URL

fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Gotcha: Build tag in the URL

fr:mainmatter.html:p: The generator stamps the capture endpoint with ?build=vN so server access logs reveal which version of the shortcut actually fired. iCloud Shortcuts sync lag is silent — an iPad can keep running a stale copy for many minutes after a new .shortcut lands in Files. Without the build tag there is no way to tell a broken shortcut apart from a not-yet-synced one.
Top of ~/forest/utils/gen-capture-shortcuts.py — bump BUILD on every regen:
fr:mainmatter.html:pre: BUILD = "v3-formwired" # bump on each regen so server logs reveal which build fired ENDPOINT = f"http://macproseph:8889/capture?build={BUILD}"

fr:mainmatter.html:p: For Capture File, a preceding Set Variable action does not capture the share-sheet payload. The share-sheet input arrives as ExtensionInput and has to be bound on the Download URL action itself via WFRequestVariable, not piped through an earlier variable. Without this, the POST body is empty even though the shortcut appears to "run" on the file.
